observations: The document is titled 'Einvernehmungs-Protocoll' (Consensus Protocol). It references 'Ablösungs-Contract Nr: 22' regarding the property 'Grübln' (or Grünbichl). The date of the protocol is April 5, 1830, though the text mentions a lease contract from April 2nd. The word 'Abgenommen' is crossed out with a thick horizontal line. The handwriting is in Kurrent script on pinkish paper.
